name: Capture creation
summary: Recording site data at a project location and time with the mobile app: capture modes, grouping into snapshots, duplicate detection, and registering files to upload.

roles.note: Capturing is a project action. The project must also be in an access stage that allows it (PROJ-REQ-015).

actions.action: Capture and submit a capture session

nfr.statement: Largest capture session (files and total size per capture, captures per day per project) that must succeed.
nfr.open_question: What are the largest 360 video and drone sessions customers upload today, and what must we support?

requirements.title: Assigned users capture site data on mobile and upload it
requirements.statement: A user assigned to a project signs in to the mobile app, finds the project, captures site data and uploads it. Offline capture and resume promises are not established until a released mobile build is reviewed.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger
Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)

open_checks: The released mobile app is not in the inspected repositories; offline capture, upload resume and app-version contracts are unverified

acceptance_criteria.given: A collaborator assigned to project P, on site with the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.when: They select P, choose a location, capture and upload
acceptance_criteria.then: A capture for that location and date exists in P and its files upload

requirements.title: A repeated capture from the same device is reused
requirements.statement: Creating a capture reuses an existing one with the same device, capture time and structure, so a retried submission doesn't create a duplicate. Without a device ID a new capture is always created.
open_checks: The check reads before it creates, so two concurrent submissions can both create; the project isn't part of the match; partial registration needs repair on retry

acceptance_criteria.given: A capture from device D at 10:02 on structure S
acceptance_criteria.when: The app resubmits the same capture after a timeout
acceptance_criteria.then: The existing capture is returned and no second capture is created

requirements.title: Captures are grouped into snapshots by structure and local date
requirements.statement: New captures are grouped by structure and by date in the project's time zone. Each group is attached to the snapshot for that structure and day, which is created if needed. Capture records are created before upload sessions are registered, and a capture that already existed gets no new upload session.

acceptance_criteria.given: A project in America/Chicago, and two captures on structure S at 23:30 and 00:30 local time
acceptance_criteria.then: They are attached to snapshots for two different local dates

requirements.title: Seven capture modes
requirements.statement: A capture has one mode: 360 video, 360 image, phone image, phone video, LiDAR scan, drone image or laser. Which modes each project type supports isn't decided (DEC-028).

sources.title: Track3D "Single Source of Truth" docs, generated from code

acceptance_criteria.then: It is rejected as an unknown mode
